sampling: 100 random interior points in each of 14 district boundaries
target_definition: Four-class experimental public-data suitability screening target derived from the documented weak-label rules
confidence_definition: Evidence/completeness strength for the weak label; not a calibrated probability of safety

feature_notes.flood_occurrence: JRC Global Surface Water occurrence percentage; it is not historical flood-event frequency
feature_notes.terrain_ruggedness_index: 3x3 SRTM elevation standard deviation proxy in metres
feature_notes.soil: OpenLandMap predicted surface values at 0 cm; organic carbon raw values divided by 5, pH divided by 10 per catalog scale
feature_notes.terrain_zone: Analytical elevation class: lowland <=20m, midland 20-300m, highland >300m; not an official Kerala physiographic classification
feature_notes.distances: Straight-line metres to the nearest mapped OSM geometry; completeness varies and legal/route access is not established
feature_notes.seismic_zone: Statewide Zone III generalization from KSDMA; site response and local geology are not represented

sources.hazards: KSDMA historic flood polygons, current GSI 2022 district landslide shapefiles, and UNEP/KSDMA historical flood-return rasters

limitations: Random sample points are not cadastral parcels
Weak labels reproduce documented public-data assumptions rather than observed building outcomes
No bearing-capacity test, title, zoning, permit, CRZ decision, sewage, crime, price, noise, air-quality, or verified utility service
Not mapped means unknown, never safe
Expert review is required before interpreting the target as construction suitability
weak_label_warning: Rule-derived public-data screening target; not expert ground truth, a permit decision, or proof that a site is safe

weak_label_rule_summary.hazard: Largest weight: GSI 2022 susceptibility, modeled flood return period and water level, mapped water, and older flood reference
weak_label_rule_summary.terrain: Slope, local elevation variability, and a high-rainfall/steep-slope interaction
weak_label_rule_summary.environmental_conflict: Proximity to surface water, quarries, waste facilities, industrial land, and mapped power lines
weak_label_rule_summary.access: Straight-line distance to the nearest mapped road
weak_label_rule_summary.amenities: Straight-line distance to mapped hospitals, schools, and bus stops
weak_label_rule_summary.excluded_from_scoring: Surface soil predictions are retained as model inputs but do not claim bearing capacity; legal title, parcel zoning, CRZ, sewage, crime, price, noise, air quality, and verified utility service remain unavailable

hazard_reference_definition: Separate direct-intersection label and confidence from the older KSDMA/NCESS polygons, retained for provenance
